comment: U7 LP5912-3.3DRVR unused PG pad3 is intentionally grounded. TI LP5912 Rev D section8.3.6 explicitly permits ground or floating when PG is unused; section6 maps PG3/GND5. https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lp5912.pdf SHA25656e9603fe47c816f08cfa136acc717f7901b2d526047bf949c5e6f44b6ca31ee. Only this exact PG3-to-GND PWR_FLAG marker is excluded. Physical nets, ERC severity table and pin map are unchanged.
